facts.text: Disparaging statements, including on review platforms, may lead to immediate termination and forfeiture of profits.
facts.excerpt: Traders must communicate respectfully with Top One Futures staff and community members. Disparaging, false, or misleading statements about Top One Futures are strictly prohibited, including on review platforms, social media, or forums. Violations may result in immediate account termination and forfeiture of profits.
